[P3] Document the changed test contracts before proceeding

Rule 5.4 requires edited test expectations and their reasons to be listed in the PR description. This changes `test_invocation_is_released_when_span_shutdown_fails` from expecting `RuntimeError` to expecting `ExceptionGroup`; status-mapping and worker-context expectations also change elsewhere, but the description does not identify those tests. These are changes to observable contracts, not merely additional coverage. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and record the intended contract and rationale for each changed expectation.
